title: Great Smoky Mountains Hikes GPX Routes, 10 Best Day Hikes, Smokies Trail Guide PDF, Hiking Passport, AllTrails Gaia GPS, Gatlinburg Trip
description:
America's most-visited national park, told through its ten best day hikes: waterfalls, grassy balds, rock outcrops and the park's highest summit. GPS routes for your phone, real photos, elevation profiles and a trail passport.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 10 GPX route files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or a GPS watch
- Route guide with a real photo, route map, elevation profile, trailhead logistics and tips for every trail
- A fillable Trail Passport to log every hike
- 10 collectible trail badges plus a shareable story image for every hike
- Alum Cave, Chimney Tops, Andrews Bald, Rainbow Falls, Grotto Falls, Abrams Falls, Charlies Bunion, Ramsey Cascades, Kuwohi Observation Tower and Mouse Creek Falls, with round-trip distances from the National Park Service

WHAT YOU GET
- GPX route files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or your GPS watch
- Route guide PDF in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Trail data from the National Park Service and OpenStreetMap contributors; photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits in the guide. Conditions change, so check nps.gov/grsm before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
